links.section: Comparison with national and international evidence

links.passage: Furthermore, global literature cautions that field-level water savings may not translate into basin-level conservation due to rebound effects, including expansion of irrigated area and increased cropping intensity (Molden et al., 2001).
supporting_passages: International evidence from countries such as Israel, Spain and China highlights that micro-irrigation delivers its greatest benefits when combined with strong extension systems, precision nutrient management and robust water governance frameworks (Yang et al., 2000; Tianxue et al., 2024).
The Assam case reflects this concern, as efficiency gains are frequently used to bring additional land under irrigation rather than to reduce total water withdrawals.
links.inference_note: The cited caution on rebound effects refers to micro-irrigation named in the preceding sentence, and the following sentence states that its efficiency gains in Assam do not reduce total withdrawals.
